label: Kyoto · Paths of quiet wonder
description: Fictional Kyoto journal · gates, bamboo and temple views
title: Between vermilion and green
subtitle: Three days in Kyoto, remembered one small moment at a time.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We arrived at Fushimi Inari Taisha and walked beneath the vermilion gates. I kept pausing to look up.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: The red gates are the part I want to remember. Let us keep this photo.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We walked through the bamboo grove in Arashiyama. We took our time and enjoyed being there together.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: The bamboo made this feel like a different side of Kyoto.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We visited Kiyomizu-dera and looked out across Kyoto. It was our last stop before heading home.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: I would love to come back and walk these streets again.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: We walked through Gion that evening. I wanted to keep the narrow street and its old wooden facades in our journal.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: After the bamboo grove we stopped beside Togetsu-kyo Bridge. We watched the river before walking back together.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: Another photograph from our last stop at Kiyomizu-dera: the temple hall, framed by the trees. Please keep this view alongside the city panorama.

label: Paris · A little time by the Seine
description: Fictional Paris journal · river views and the Louvre
title: A little time by the Seine
subtitle: Two days of looking up, slowing down, and keeping the small things.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We stopped beside the Seine to look at the Eiffel Tower. I had seen it in pictures, but wanted a photo of this moment.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: My favorite part was having no hurry to leave the river.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We went inside the Louvre Pyramid. We took a photo looking through the glass.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: Let us use the river photo for the cover and keep the Louvre photo in the second chapter.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: We followed the Seine to Pont Alexandre III and stopped for this view of the bridge. Looking at the details became part of our walk.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: Later we went up to Montmartre and stood outside Sacre-Coeur. I took this photograph to remember the building against the sky.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: After the Louvre we walked through the Tuileries Garden. We found a place to pause and kept this photograph of the garden.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We ended our walk outside Notre-Dame. This older licensed illustration stands in for the facade in our fictional travel journal; it is not a photograph taken on our sample travel date.

label: New York · The city, at our pace
description: Fictional New York journal · Brooklyn Bridge and Central Park
title: The city, at our pace
subtitle: From the bridge to the park, two days of finding our own New York.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We walked onto Brooklyn Bridge and stopped to look at the Manhattan skyline. This is the photo I wanted to bring home.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: The bridge is my favorite memory of our first day.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We spent our second day in Central Park and took a photo beside the lake.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: It felt good to slow down after our walk across the bridge.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: We walked through DUMBO and saw Manhattan Bridge framed by the buildings on Washington Street. Another angle on a city full of bridges.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We reached Times Square later in the day. The signs and yellow taxis filled the view; this photograph belongs with our first day in the city.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: Still in Central Park, we stopped at Bethesda Terrace. I wanted to keep the stonework as well as the photograph beside the lake.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: Our last photograph is from inside Grand Central Terminal. We paused in the concourse before leaving, looking up one more time.

label: Santorini · Aegean days
description: Fictional Santorini journal · white villages, volcanic beaches and the Aegean Sea
title: Where the island meets the blue
subtitle: Three days of sea views, village walks and moments worth keeping.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We arrived in Oia and stopped to look at the white buildings above the Aegean Sea. This was the first photograph I wanted to keep.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: We went down to Ammoudi Bay and took a photograph of the harbour beneath the cliffs. I liked seeing the village from this different angle.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: We paused above the caldera in Fira. We had no hurry to leave the sea view.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: Later we walked beside Perissa Beach. We watched the sea and kept this photograph of the shoreline.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: On our last day we looked across Red Beach from the viewpoint. The red cliffs and blue water belong together in our album.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: We ended the trip watching the sunset over the sea. I would love to come back and take our time here again.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: The sea is the thread I want to follow through this book.

posts.author: traveler
posts.text: Please keep the village views and the beach photographs together.

posts.author: hana
posts.text: Three days, six photographs, and so many reasons to return.
